purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century personal microscopic preparations and NHM foraminiferal/pseudofossil collections recovered through deep search.
guards: Do not equate historical production totals with current surviving totals.
Preserve sample-to-slide derivation and later departmental transfer separately from original preparation and accession.
Use publication-linked slides and syntypes as item anchors without inferring a total from species counts.

adapters.institution_scope: Naturhistorisches Museum Wien Archive for the History of Science
adapters.target: official archive treasures and selected physical-object records for Ferdinand I preparations
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture illustrated/selected surviving preparations and personal preparation attribution; keep original thousands-made statement distinct from current surviving count and later didactic museum use.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum London Williamson Foraminifera collection
adapters.target: peer-reviewed Williamson slide study plus NHM registers/Data Portal discovery
adapters.promotion_rule: Extract surviving publication-linked slide/species records and current catalogue identifiers; retain 1896 museum arrival as later custody event and do not infer slide total from taxa.

adapters.institution_scope: Natural History Museum London W.B. Carpenter Eozoon collection
adapters.target: peer-reviewed conservation/collection study and NHM catalogue discovery
adapters.promotion_rule: Model sample-to-slide production, 1892 donation, multiple storage locations, 1949 departmental transfer and current split custody as separate events; enumerate extant slides/samples only from catalogue or inventory evidence.
